The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, chosen by the municipal council in an indirect election. The shared note naming Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala appears to be wrong, since Koirala was a Nepali Congress leader and prime minister, not Kathmandu's mayor. I still can't check a source from this session, so please verify against Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors.

CONFIDENCE: 65
